query:
SELECT cc.nome, SUM(lc.valor) as total
FROM lancamento_custo lc
JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 30002
GROUP BY cc.nome
ORDER BY total DESC
